title: fantasy-rogue: combat / actors / items / ui / assets - engine-extraction review
summary: Code review of the previous fantasy-rogue game's combat, actors, items, ui and assets, grading subsystems for engine extraction and giving ranked recommendations for the new engine.
notes: Evidence document under docs/reviews/ cited by docs/PLAN.md. Contains ranked recommendations (F1-F9) that resemble decisions, but it has no Status/Decision/Consequences structure and nothing is accepted here; the locked decisions live in PLAN.md. Classified DOC (context). Contains no requirements or specification contracts. Output filename uses an 'unhashed' suffix, like the sibling classifications, because no SHA-256 tool was available. Only the first 651 of 772 lines were read; the rest continues the F-series recommendations.
